register.createdBody: Save your recovery code somewhere safe. It's the only way to reset your password — it won't be shown again.
register.title: Create account
register.inviteHelp: Enter the code from your invitation. It only works for the email address you were invited with.
register.displayNamePlaceholder: How you want to be addressed
register.toLogin: Already have an account? Sign in

reset.doneBody: Your password was updated. Save your new recovery code — it replaces the old one.
reset.title: Reset password
reset.intro: Enter your email, the recovery code you received when creating your account, and a new password.

welcome.title: Welcome to Bandsearch
welcome.body: Bandsearch finds niche music with AI language models hosted by Scaleway in France. Add a Scaleway API key once on this device, then you can start chatting. You can change it anytime in Settings.

connecting.waitingBody: This can take a moment if the server has been idle.
connecting.longWaitBody: A server that has been idle can take up to a minute to wake up.
connecting.failedBody: The server did not respond. Check your connection, or the API endpoint in Settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your keys are stored locally on this device and passed to the Bandsearch API process.
settings.missingKeys_one: {{names}} API key is not configured yet. Add it below so recommendations can run.
settings.missingKeys_other: {{names}} API keys are not configured yet. Add them below so recommendations can run.
settings.keyReplace: Enter a new key to replace the saved key
settings.braveKeyPlaceholder: Paste your Brave Search API key

turso.title: Turso cross-device sync
turso.intro: Add a Turso database URL to sync your saved artists across devices. Your local data won’t transfer automatically — export it first, then import after switching.
turso.connected: Connected to Turso. Your local SQLite data is still on this device — switch back any time.
turso.urlReplace: Enter a new URL to replace the saved URL
turso.tokenReplace: Enter a new token to replace the saved token

endpoint.title: API endpoint
endpoint.remote: Connected to a remote API at {{url}}. The built-in local app is not started while a remote endpoint is set.
endpoint.local: Using the built-in local app. Enter a remote URL to connect to a hosted Bandsearch API instead.
endpoint.urlReplace: Enter a new URL to replace the saved endpoint
endpoint.keysInactive: A remote endpoint is active — the keys below configure the built-in local app and apply only if you reset to local.

privacy.title: Privacy & data
privacy.intro: Read what Bandsearch collects and why, or download a copy of everything it holds about you.
privacy.deleteWarning: Deleting your account erases your saved artists, groups and chat history. This cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteConfirm: Confirm your password to delete this account permanently

status.keySaved: Saved. The API process was restarted with your key.
status.keyStoredInBrowser: Stored in browser storage (development only). Use a .env file or the desktop app for production.
status.braveKeyEmpty: Enter a non-empty Brave API key.
status.braveKeySaved: Saved. The API process was restarted with your Brave key.
status.tursoSaved: Saved. Syncing via Turso from next restart.
status.endpointInvalid: Enter a valid http(s) URL, or leave blank to use the built-in local app.
status.endpointSaved: Saved. The app will use the remote API from the next restart.
status.endpointReset: Reset. The app will use the built-in local API from the next restart.

language.title: Language
language.chatNote: Chat replies follow the language you write in.

savedArtists.title: Saved Artists
savedArtists.subtitle: Your style references
savedArtists.empty: No saved artists yet. Save artists from recommendation cards.

status.importedFailed_one: Imported {{count}} artist; {{failed}} could not be imported.
status.importedFailed_other: Imported {{count}} artists; {{failed}} could not be imported.
status.notAnExport: That file isn't a Bandsearch export.
status.loadFailed: Could not load your saved artists.

errors.rateLimited: Too many recommendation requests in a short window. Wait about a minute, then try again.
errors.starting: Recommendations are still starting up. Wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.musicBrainzUnavailable: Music lookup (MusicBrainz) is temporarily unavailable. Check your network connection and try again.
errors.searchUnavailable: Web search (Brave) is temporarily unavailable. Check your network connection and try again in a moment.
errors.modelUnavailable: The AI model could not return recommendations. Open Settings and confirm your Scaleway API key; if it is correct, the model may be busy or unreachable — try again in a moment.
errors.invalidRequest: That request could not be processed. Try rephrasing your message.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.unreachableStarting: Could not reach the Bandsearch API. If the app just started, wait until the API is ready, then try again.
errors.unreachable: Could not reach the Bandsearch API. Check that the API server is running.
errors.searchLost: This search was lost: the server restarted or kept it too long. Retry to ask again.
errors.searchCancelled: This search was stopped, perhaps by a newer search on another device. Retry to ask again.
errors.searchDisconnected: The connection to the server dropped. Your search keeps running there; Bandsearch picks it up when you come back to the app.

prototype334.title: Bandsearch
prototype334.empty: Start with 1–3 bands you already like
prototype334.sampleReply: Here are two picks with spacious guitars and a darker atmosphere.
prototype334.question: Something like Alcest and Agalloch
prototype334.disclosure: AI-generated recommendations — a language model hosted in the EU (Scaleway, France) writes the picks and the explanations, verified against MusicBrainz. Not a human curator.
prototype334.demoOnly: This screen is outside the Chat layout prototype.
prototype334.fenWhy: Patient builds and atmospheric guitars, close to your Alcest reference.
prototype334.fenConnection: A darker, more expansive companion to Alcest and Agalloch.
prototype334.wodenWhy: Raw woodland atmosphere with long, slowly changing passages.
prototype334.wodenConnection: For the folk textures and patient pacing in Agalloch.
prototype334.earlierWhy: An earlier pick with warm, layered guitars.
prototype334.info: All changes here stay in this sample. Closing the app returns to the installed app.
